behavior_before: The auto-generation summary printed an empty-report count initialized to zero but never updated it, even when the existing checker warned that primary report sections had no rows.
behavior_after: The checker returns whether any recognized primary content section is an empty list, and auto-generation counts that report only after its draft snapshot is stored successfully.
new_regressions: empty primary sections return an empty signal and preserve the warning
populated primary sections return a non-empty signal without a warning
auto-generation summary counts a successfully stored empty report
behavioral_scope: Snapshot lifecycle, persisted success/failure statuses, report payloads, and SQL are unchanged. The empty count is diagnostic and does not change whether an empty report is stored as a draft.
